integrity: The proof uses an explicit exchange inequality for abundancy, a verified largest-prime cutoff, and an exact-rational exhaustive checker. Originality comparisons included the focal full text, OEIS A005231, later work on the signed-divisor conjectures, targeted web searches, targeted mathematical-result database searches, and previously checked overlapping classifications.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the multiplicity-five boundary of odd abundant integers. It does not classify higher multiplicity layers. Exhaustiveness uses a symbolic largest-prime bound followed by exact rational finite enumeration.
title: The complete first multiplicity layer of odd abundant numbers
